name: Core Skill Kit
description: 15 of 25 core skills included in this free starter kit; the rest are available in the full hub.

integrations.description: CRUD operations for Fathom, GitHub, Google, Jira, Linear, Notion, Slack; includes project-brain aggregator and recent-changes-alert

llm-selector.description: Evaluate a SKILL.md → recommend LLM + fallbacks + cost

skill-recommender.description: Given tech stack → suggest existing skills or flag gaps
skill-recommender.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

task-router.description: Step 0 pre-flight: route tasks to phi4-mini/qwen/sonnet/opus + identify red/yellow gates

ollama-task-router.description: Annotate plans with LOCAL vs CLOUD routing for Ollama models

memory-recommender.description: Given project characteristics → recommend memory system + emit config.yaml
memory-recommender.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

memory-advisor.description: Provision/track/update memory systems per-project; assess project memory needs
memory-advisor.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

skill-builder.description: Draft, test, iterate on new skills; knows ug-ug/memory/gstack patterns

skill-linter.description: Validates SKILL.md format; ensures all required sections exist

operator.description: Orchestrator that routes requests to the right bot/skill
operator.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

reflect.description: Terminal retrospective; writes LESSONS.md, surfaces memory promotions

session-handover.description: Auto-MindPalace at context limit; structured handover to HANDOVER.md

claude-md-sync.description: Diffs skill folders on disk vs CLAUDE.md inventory; detects drift
claude-md-sync.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

notify.description: Alert humans when gates open/close or blocking conditions arise

agent-setup-wizard.description: Multi-phase wizard with ug-ug assignment + MindPalace + GStack config generation

project-env-setup.description: Generates docker-compose.yml, .env templates, local stack bootstrap

local-runner.description: Executes task_router-annotated plans on local Ollama instead of cloud
local-runner.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

engagement-config-setup.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

orchestrator.description: Master coordinator for complex multi-skill workflows
orchestrator.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

skillmaster.description: Core loop: reads task, selects skills from CLAUDE.md, orchestrates execution
skillmaster.upgrade: Available in the full hub / paid pack

chat-primer.description: Session-start ritual — emits SESSION READY card, validates ug-ug/memory/vault/Ollama state

ug-ug_application.notes: Plans (strategic decisions): maximum compression, structure-first. Internal reasoning (debug/analysis): terse bullets, skip narrative. User responses (chat): normal prose, clear communication.

installation.memory_setup: memory-ladder for cross-session memory (run agent-setup-wizard to configure)
installation.next_step: Run agent-setup-wizard to select core skills and tech-specific skills for your project
